result.summary: The page appears largely well-formed. No critical or major visual defects were found; layout, spacing, and imagery all render as expected. Only a couple of minor cosmetic/accessibility observations were noted.

issues.description: The search field placeholder text ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a light gray background, giving fairly low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color slightly to meet WCAG contrast guidelines for placeholder text.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the pizza card near the bottom uses a dark translucent circle over a dark wooden background, making the icon blend into the image and reducing its visibility.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent light/frosted background for the favorite button (as on the ramen card) or add a subtle border/shadow so it stands out on dark images.
